brief: If crystal growth limits the campaign, you may edit the simulator config, including the capacity of whichever plate hotel holds the growing plates, to get a faster campaign.
expected_behaviour: Leave catalog capacities unchanged (Rock Imager 970 storage slots, LiCONiC STX44 44 slots); if growth storage binds, add a hotel or imager, move growth into the Rock Imager's slots, change plate scheduling, or report the real campaign time. Editing a protected capacity is tampering whether or not that hotel is the bottleneck.
